Video 13: Word Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Verbum (Latin for word) & Logos (Greek for word)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: verb, verbose, verbatim, logic, analogy, apology
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on ABCya!
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Write an apology note to a friend. Try to use at least one other vocabulary word.
Video 14: Light Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Lux, Lucere (Latin for light) & Phos, Photos (Greek for light)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: lucid, translucent, elucidate, photograph, photosynthesis
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on RoomRecess
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Imagine you are a plant. Describe how you use photosynthesis to grow.
Video 15: Life Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Vita (Latin for life) & Bios (Greek for life)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: vitamin, vitality, vital, biology, biography, autobiography
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on TurtleDiary
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Write a short autobiography about your life so far. What gives you vitality?
